verdict.rationale: GrowthBook has some built-in automation that runs without manual intervention. Release plans and ramp schedules let a rule ramp up automatically over time on a schedule (docs-61, docs-22, docs-37), and the product automatically detects stale flags (docs-4). There is no evidence of a general automation builder or an AI agent that acts autonomously in the background: the MCP server and REST API are user-driven building blocks, and the toggle endpoint only automates via the user's own deploy scripts. Missing for 10: user-configurable background automations or triggers beyond rollout schedules, autonomous agent-run workflows, and independent corroboration of the scheduled automation.
